The suspect, identified as Warris Kareem, was arrested by police operatives following intelligence gathering and security operations aimed at curbing criminal activities across the state.
The Police Public Relations Officer, Lagos State Command, SP Abimbola Adebisi, disclosed this in a statement issued to newsmen.
According to the statement, preliminary investigations revealed that Kareem allegedly participated in robbery operations targeting members of the public around the Alaba Suru and Orile axis alongside other members of his suspected criminal gang.
A locally made pistol was reportedly recovered from the suspect during the operation.
The police said the suspect was currently in custody, while efforts were ongoing to track down and arrest other members of the alleged gang who escaped.
According to the Command, the development forms part of its sustained efforts to prevent crime, maintain public safety and protect lives and property in the state.
The Commissioner of Police, Lagos State Command, CP Tijani Fatai, reiterated the Command’s commitment to intelligence-driven and proactive policing, assuring residents that security operations would be sustained to curb criminal activities.
He, however, urged residents to remain vigilant and promptly report suspicious movements and activities to security agencies, stressing the importance of public cooperation in preventing crime.
The Command also encouraged members of the public to utilise its emergency telephone lines to report security concerns.
The police assured residents that necessary operational measures would continue to be deployed to safeguard lives and property and prevent criminal elements from using Lagos as a haven.
Meanwhile, Kareem’s arrest comes amid ongoing police efforts to strengthen security surveillance and enforcement operations across communities in the state.
